article.title: Common mistake: 'discuss about' vs 'discuss'
article.description: Wrong: 'Let's discuss about the plan.' Right: 'Let's discuss the plan.' Teaching point: 'discuss' is a transitive verb that already means 'talk about' — adding 'about' after it is redundant, though very common among learners.
